items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: Standard empty state for 'no data' and 'no results' cases. Default and inline variants. Slots for icon, title, description, primary + secondary action.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: ConfirmDialog (imperative)
items.description: Imperative `await confirm({ title, description })` API backed by AlertDialog. Drop the provider at the app root, then call useConfirm() from anywhere — no JSX boilerplate.

items.name: loading-button
items.title: LoadingButton
items.description: Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Button with a built-in spinner + disabled state when `loading` is true. Saves the inline conditional on every async action.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: Click-to-copy button with a 'copied' success state and a Clipboard API fallback for older browsers.

items.name: error-boundary
items.title: ErrorBoundary + DefaultFallback
items.description: React error boundary with a styled default fallback (matches design tokens), a retry callback, optional resetKey to clear errors on route/data change, and an onError hook for monitoring (Sentry / captureException).

items.name: skeletons
items.title: Layout-matched skeletons (Table / CardGrid / DetailPage / Form / StatRow)
items.description: Pre-built skeleton variants matching standard page layouts. Drop in as <Suspense> fallbacks so the page silhouette stays in place while data loads.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toaster + toast (Sonner preset)
items.description: Pre-configured Sonner toaster with framework design tokens, plus a typed `toast` helper that extends Sonner with a `confirm` variant for low-stakes inline confirmations. Drop <Toaster /> once near root and call toast.success/error/promise from anywhere.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer (responsive side panel / bottom sheet)
items.description: Side panel for detail views and quick-edit forms. Right-anchored on desktop with configurable width preset (sm/md/lg/xl/full), bottom sheet on mobile (< 640px). Built-in header / footer slots so consumers don't repeat the chrome.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip (standardised wrapper)
items.description: Wraps the shadcn Tooltip primitives — consistent delay, sizing, alignment. Replaces the four-component boilerplate at every call site. Re-exports TooltipProvider for one-import convenience.

items.name: modal
items.title: ModalProvider + useModal + Modal slot helpers
items.description: Stack-aware imperative modal manager. Drop <ModalProvider> + <ModalRoot /> once near root; call modal.open(({ close }) => <Modal>…</Modal>) from anywhere. FIFO stack, Esc / backdrop closes topmost, size presets.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner (dismissible announcement)
items.description: Site-wide banner with info / success / warning / destructive variants. Dismissal persists per `id` via localStorage. Bump the id when copy changes to re-surface.

items.name: global-loading-bar
items.title: GlobalLoadingBar
items.description: Top progress bar that animates during App Router route transitions. Detects anchor-click navigations, animates to ~80%, completes on pathname / searchParams change. No nprogress dependency.
